population: 48 frozen, family-disjoint Qwen3.6 native discovery traces; 12,274 full 64-reasoning-token windows
multiplicity_family: three descriptive native-motion scalars; Bonferroni percentile family bootstrap, 5,000 replicates
interpretation: TV change in selected-gate distribution between consecutive full windows, averaged across layers then equally across frozen families. The approximate interval describes discovery-family heterogeneity, not a representative population or semantic control.

population: 48 frozen, family-disjoint Qwen3.6 native discovery traces; complete triples of 64-reasoning-token windows
multiplicity_family: three descriptive native-motion scalars; Bonferroni percentile family bootstrap, 5,000 replicates
interpretation: L1/2 magnitude of the second difference of consecutive gate-distribution windows, averaged across layers then equally across frozen families. It is not an optimal acceleration pattern.

population: 48 frozen, family-disjoint Qwen3.6 native discovery traces; complete pairs of 64-reasoning-token windows
multiplicity_family: three descriptive native-motion scalars; Bonferroni percentile family bootstrap, 5,000 replicates
interpretation: One minus top-eight expert-set overlap divided by eight between complete windows, averaged across layers then equally across frozen families. Exposure and turnover do not establish useful reasoning control.
